whats.Microsoft's 60,000-employee exit offer a: A huge exit offer alongside a bold AI agent vision signals Microsoft expects AI to reshape how work gets staffed.
whats.Planet Labs CEO Says Geopolitical Shifts: Defense spending tied to AI is now a bigger growth driver for space companies than commercial demand, says Planet Labs' CEO.
whats.Chilli Fruit Web Consulting Ranked #1 AI: Being ranked top for AI visibility shows brands increasingly need specialised help to be found by AI search tools.
whats.From mapping to AI-powered spatial intel: India's geospatial sector shifting to AI-powered spatial intelligence could open new planning and infrastructure opportunities.
whats.Nexawork AI Launches Custom Software for: Affordable custom AI software launches show smaller businesses now have real options to adopt AI without big budgets.

term.def: Spatial intelligence is AI's ability to read maps, locations and physical layouts, helping tools spot patterns in geography, assets and movement.

prompt.prompt: Using our [warehouse and store locations] data, suggest three ways AI could help us cut delivery time or costs across [region].

quiz.q: India Today reports Microsoft offered an exit package to 60,000 employees while Nadella spoke of a vision of 20 million AI agents.
quiz.why: This restates what India Today's headline states about Microsoft's offer and Nadella's agent vision.

quiz.q: TechCrunch reports Yale's Jeffrey Sonnenfeld estimates Jensen Huang's job security at about 50-50.
quiz.why: This matches the quoted estimate in the TechCrunch headline, nothing more is claimed.

quiz.q: AI models reason and think exactly the way the human brain does.
quiz.why: AI finds patterns in data using math, not biological thought, so it does not reason like a human brain.

quiz.q: AI always gives accurate answers because it is a machine and machines do not make mistakes.
quiz.why: AI can be confidently wrong or make up details, a problem often called hallucination.

quiz.q: The same AI tool can give slightly different answers to the exact same question asked twice.
quiz.why: Many AI systems use some randomness in generating answers, so responses can vary even for identical prompts.
